gaps: Exact fees/late-registration fees and time limits for each vital event are only partly stated in the FAQ pages; no standalone fee schedule page was found.

Citizen charter and the Acts/Rules/Directive category pages are JavaScript-rendered listings; their PDFs are on giwmscdnone.gov.np, which refused automated connections, so Act/Rules text, charter service times and notice PDF contents (children's NIN, local registrar duties, birth certificate correction, refugee minors, registration week) could not be read.
Ward-office online registration list, NID lost/damaged card replacement beyond the FAQ, and card printing/distribution timelines are not covered by crawled pages.
Downloadable forms were not accessible.
